note.title: recon pipeline completo
note.intro: encadeamento de todas as ferramentas de recon numa pipeline unica. do dominio aos findings. util pra bug bounty continuo e pentest de superficie de ataque.
commands:
#!/bin/bash
DOMAIN=$1
OUTDIR="recon/$DOMAIN"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

# 1. subdominios passivos
echo "[*] subdominios passivos..."
subfinder -d "$DOMAIN" -all -silent > "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt"
chaos -d "$DOMAIN" -silent >> "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt"
curl -s "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.$DOMAIN&output=json" | jq -r '.[].name_value' | sed 's/\*\.//g' >> "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt"
sort -u "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt" -o "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt"

# 2. permuutacoes
alterx -l "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt" -enrich -o "$OUTDIR/permutations.txt"
puredns resolve "$OUTDIR/permutations.txt" -r resolvers.txt -w "$OUTDIR/subs_perms.txt"

# 3. juntar e resolver
cat "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt" "$OUTDIR/subs_perms.txt" | sort -u | dnsx -silent > "$OUTDIR/subs_resolved.txt"

# 4. http probe
cat "$OUTDIR/subs_resolved.txt" | httpx -silent -status-code -title -tech-detect -follow-redirects -o "$OUTDIR/live.txt"

# 5. screenshots
cat "$OUTDIR/subs_resolved.txt" | httpx -silent -screenshot -screenshot-dir "$OUTDIR/screens/"

echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/subs_passive.txt") subs passivos"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/subs_resolved.txt") subs resolvidos"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/live.txt") vivos"

# 6. crawl
katana -list "$OUTDIR/live.txt" -d 2 -jc -silent -o "$OUTDIR/katana_urls.txt"
gau "$DOMAIN" --subs -o "$OUTDIR/gau_urls.txt"
waybackurls "$DOMAIN" | sort -u >> "$OUTDIR/gau_urls.txt"

# 7. filtrar urls
cat "$OUTDIR/katana_urls.txt" "$OUTDIR/gau_urls.txt" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt"
cat "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" | grep "=" | qsreplace "FUZZ" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/params.txt"
cat "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" | grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/js_files.txt"
cat "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" | grep -iE "api|graphql|v1|v2|rest" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/api.txt"

# 8. js analysis
grep -rnE "api[_-]?key|secret|token|password|aws_|firebase" "$OUTDIR/js/" > "$OUTDIR/js_secrets.txt"

# 9. nuclei
nuclei -l "$OUTDIR/live.txt" -t ~/nuclei-templates/ -severity medium,high,critical -o "$OUTDIR/nuclei.txt"

echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt") urls"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/params.txt") com parametros"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/js_files.txt") arquivos js"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/nuclei.txt") findings nuclei"

# 10. ASN e ranges
dig A "$DOMAIN" +short > "$OUTDIR/domain_ips.txt"
sort -u "$OUTDIR/domain_ips.txt" | while read ip; do
  curl -s "https://api.bgpview.io/ip/$ip" | jq -r '.data.prefixes[].prefix' 2>/dev/null
done | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/ip_ranges.txt"

# 11. reverse PTR
cat "$OUTDIR/ip_ranges.txt" | prips - | dnsx -ptr -resp-only -r resolvers.txt -o "$OUTDIR/ptr_records.txt"
grep -i "$DOMAIN" "$OUTDIR/ptr_records.txt" > "$OUTDIR/target_ptrs.txt"

echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/ip_ranges.txt") ranges"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/ptr_records.txt") ptr records"

# rodar pipeline periodicamente e comparar
diff "$OUTDIR/../old_subs.txt" "$OUTDIR/subs_resolved.txt" | grep ">" | sed 's/^> //' > "$OUTDIR/new_subs.txt"
if [ -s "$OUTDIR/new_subs.txt" ]; then
  cat "$OUTDIR/new_subs.txt" | notify -provider telegram
fi
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/new_subs.txt") subs novos desde ultima run"

# do dominio aos findings em uma linha
subfinder -d alvo.com -all -silent | alterx -enrich | puredns resolve -r resolvers.txt | httpx -silent -status-code -title | nuclei -t ~/nuclei-templates/ -severity medium,high | notify -provider telegram
